correctness.rationale: The closed form R_n^(s)=2^(n-2-2c_s(n))*3^c_s(n) for n>=2, with c_s(n)=max(0,floor(n/s)-1_{s=2,3}), follows by induction from the actual variable-order recurrence using reset multipliers 3/2 and ordinary multipliers 2. Positivity of exponents and strict increase from index 2 are checked at the starting values. Unique 2- and 3-adic valuations force common positive terms (including 1 counted only once) to occur at identical n. For 4<=k<ell matching floor quotients yield disjoint q=0 and q>=1 intervals of lengths k-2 and k-q(ell-k), giving the precise sum, last index k^2-1 for ell=k+1 and no later matches. The k=2,3 exceptional tables are explicitly verified by their shifted floor functions. Independent arbitrary-precision recurrence generation for s=2..13 and n<=249 reproduced the theorem across all 66 pairs. Those tests corroborate, not prove, the unrestricted interval argument.
